levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Questions are generic and could apply to any job (e.g., 'is it fun').

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least three of five questions are specific to this job and could not be answered by a general web search.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Questions probe day-to-day reality, entry path, and one honest tradeoff of the job.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Conversation happened but the learner needed heavy adult prompting to ask questions.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Learner asked at least three prepared questions and shared only first name and questions.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Learner asked follow-up questions beyond the prepared five based on what the person said.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Summary restates a fact without connecting it to the learner's own thinking.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Summary names a specific, useful piece of information and states whether it changed the learner's interest.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Reflection names a specific reason for the shift in interest, not a vague 'it was interesting.'

lookFors: The five warm-up questions are specific to the named job, not generic.
The learner's checklist confirms an adult helped set up contact and confirms only first name/questions were shared.
The reflection response names a concrete cause for the shift, or explicitly states there was no shift and why.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
